Dear Parent,

Greetings.

Kindly note that the Bridge Classes (Hybrid Mode) for the academic year 2026–27 will commence from 9th, April 2026 to 5th, May 2026 on Monday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday between 11:00 am to 2:00pm.

The credentials of the online classes will be shared by the Aakash team two days prior to the commencement of the classes.

Venue:
Aakash Institute, Banaswadi
No. M415, Building 7,
2nd Floor, Kalyan Nagar Extension,
Above Little Italy Restaurant,
HRBR Layout, Banaswadi,
Bengaluru – 560043

Transport facilities (pick-up and drop) from the nearest designated points will be provided only for the students registered for transportation.
Parents are requested to register through the portal: www.samschoolbus.com. 

Parents who wish to avail this facility are requested to fill in the details using the Google Form link shared below.
https://forms.gle/HooLrbPyTGWHQPtS8

* Disclaimer - In view of the prevailing uncertainty in the Middle East, school transport services will operate in accordance with government regulations. 
If the number of students is below the minimum requirement, the transport vendor will not be able to provide transport on that route.

Regards,
Admin
NPS NORTH
